chunks.title: CLO Skills Teaching Mini-Class - Sharing Techniques for Package Knot Making
chunks.content: ## Overview of Package Knot Making Using CLO Skills This section outlines the fundamental parameters and initial setup for creating a package knot using CLO software. Key terms include particle strength, collision thickness, fixed needle tool, and fabric physics attributes. - The rectangular plate used measures 10 mm in length and 250 mm in height. - To prepare for knotting, reduce the particle strength and verify the collision thickness, which is set at 2.5 (no adjustment necessary). - The fixed needle tool is essential for securing needles in each row during simulation. - During the knotting process, use the **W key** to add or delete fixed needles. - Pausing the simulation at key moments allows recording the simulation state to prevent unintended knot deformation. ## Using the Fixed Needle Tool for Knot Creation This section explains how to manipulate the fixed needle tool for knot formation, including adding, positioning, and deleting fixed needles to control fabric behavior. - The fixed needle tool converts the rectangular plate into a circular shape while knotting. - Pressing **W** adds a fixed needle; pressing **W** again enables selection and deletion of fixed needles. - Fixed needles stabilize specific points on the fabric, essential for maintaining knot shape during simulation. ## Fabric Setup and Folding Techniques Detailed instructions on adjusting fabric physics, folding, and sewing to adapt the rectangular board for wrapping around the rope are covered here. Terminology includes fabric physics attributes, folding arrangement tool, internal lines, and seam line marks. - Change the fabric physics attribute to **default fabric simulation** to ensure realistic fabric behavior. - Wrap the rectangular board around the rope model. - Set up two internal lines on the fabric for precise folding. - Use the **folding arrangement tool** to fold the fabric along these lines. - After folding, sew the fabric together to maintain shape integrity. - For small boards, reduce the barrier structure to improve folding accuracy. - The seam line marks on the seam side can be deleted if a clean surface is desired. - The fabric can be divided into three boards for tighter packing. - Adjust shrinkage settings to tighten the fabric around the rope. ## Adjusting Rope and Fabric Dimensions for Simulation Accuracy This section focuses on modifying rope and fabric dimensions to optimize the knotting simulation, including particle diameter, surface thickness, and seam management. - The rope is modeled with a surface thickness of 3 mm, which should be modified to 0 mm for better fit. - After adjusting the rope surface, delete the folding arrangement to finalize the shape. - The particle diameter of the fabric should be reduced to 1 to allow smooth manipulation. - If the fabric shape is too tight, it will be difficult to insert additional components like wheels. - Manage seam line marks carefully: deleting them removes visual patterns but affects fabric tightness.
